podcast.body: The title track from his 37th studio album, this song was James Brown's opening number at Zaire 74 and is described as "the embodiment of early 70s soul," reflecting his activist persona and influence. "his opening song, perhaps the pinnacle of his career is the payback, which is the embodiment of early 70s soul."

podcast.body: This 1974 funk classic is noted as one of the most sampled songs in hip-hop history. Its main hook was borrowed for En Vogue's debut hit "Hold On," and a different riff from the same song was sampled for their even bigger hit, "My Lovin' (You're Never Gonna Get It)." "Indeed, the main hook of Hold On was borrowed from James Brown's 1974 funk classic The Payback, one of the most sampled songs in hip-hop history."
